faq.question: How do I add metadata to a PDF?
faq.answer: Upload your PDF file to Converigo. The document is rebuilt with the Converigo /Producer and /Creator entries stamped in and is ready to download immediately.

faq.question: Will my PDF content change?
faq.answer: No. Page content and every other existing metadata entry are preserved exactly as-is. Only the /Producer and /Creator fields are stamped by Converigo.

faq.question: Can I edit or remove any metadata field?
faq.answer: No. This tool stamps the fixed Converigo producer and creator entries onto the document; it does not offer arbitrary metadata editing, EXIF editing, or metadata removal.

faq.question: Is it secure?
faq.answer: Yes, files are processed securely on our servers and automatically deleted after processing.

faq.question: What file sizes are supported?
faq.answer: PDF files up to 500MB can be processed instantly on Converigo.

faq.question: Can I use it on mobile?
faq.answer: Yes, Converigo works on all modern browsers and devices.
